operations.content: For codebase questions Soham wants precision over speed: index/map answers are leads only; open the real file at the stated line and verify before acting or claiming. Never present map output as verified fact.

Soham's standing setup naming: in Hermes the TrailCode servers are trailcode (own Hermes home map) and trailcode-neocoder (Neocoder project map); in Opencode the mirror names are trailcode (own map) and trailcode-neohelper (Hermes map). Keep these names stable so neither side gets confused.
